points: The format is 2 sets. If each side wins one set, a 10-point match tiebreak decides the match.
If a set reaches 6-6, play a 7-point tiebreak.
Change ends every time the total number of games in the set is odd.
When a set is over, change ends if its total number of games is odd (for example 6-3). Change again after the first game of the next set.
In a tiebreak, change ends every 6 points, unless you agreed to use the Coman tiebreak.

options: 2 sets, then a 10-point match tiebreak if each side won a set
Best of 3 full sets
2 sets, then a 7-point tiebreak if each side won a set
One long set, first to 8 games
questions.why: The format is 2 sets plus a 10-point match tiebreak, played only if the sets are tied at one each.

questions.q: A regular set reaches 6-6. What happens next?
options: A 7-point tiebreak
A 10-point tiebreak
Play on until one side leads by two games
One deciding point
questions.why: At 6-6 in a regular set, play a 7-point tiebreak.

questions.q: When is the 10-point match tiebreak played?
options: Only when each side has won one set
After the second set, in every match
Whenever a set reaches 6-6
Only when both captains ask for it
questions.why: The match tiebreak is played only if the 2 sets are tied, one set each.

questions.q: The score in the set is 2-1. Do you change ends?
options: Yes. The total number of games (3) is odd
No. You change after every two games
Only if the server asks for it
questions.why: Change ends every time the total number of games in the set is odd.

questions.q: The first set ends 6-3. What do you do about ends?
options: Change now, and change again after the first game of the second set
Stay where you are until the first game of the second set is over
Change now, then stay for the first two games of the second set
Spin the racquet again to pick ends
questions.why: The set had 9 games, an odd number, so you change. In the next set you change again after the first game, because 1 is odd too.

questions.q: The first set ends 6-4. What do you do about ends?
options: Stay for the first game of the second set, then change
Change now, and again after the first game of the second set
Change now, then stay for two games
Stay for the first two games of the second set
questions.why: The set had 10 games, an even number, so you do not change at the end of it. You change after the first game of the next set.

questions.q: In a standard tiebreak, when do you change ends?
options: Every 6 points
After the first point, then every 4 points
Every 4 points
Only when the tiebreak is over
questions.why: In a standard tiebreak you change ends every 6 points. After the first point and then every 4 is the Coman tiebreak, used only if you agreed to it.
